products.name: Valletta 2018
products.description: 4.8% ABV · 35 IBU · Valletta 2018, a bright and pleasant lager of low fermentation achieving its distinctive character through the delicate bitterness of the hop and subtle after taste of citrus.

products.name: Wild Berries Sour
products.description: 4% ABV · 5 IBU · Refreshing sour beer with the flavor and aroma of wild berries. The beer is soured by a Kettle Sour process using lactic acid bacteria.

products.name: Helles Lager
products.description: 5% ABV · 15 IBU · We make our Helles Lager using the classic European noble hops Hallertauer and Saaz which are synonymous with the traditional European style.

products.name: Belgium Stout
products.description: 5.5% ABV · 25 IBU · Belgian stout is a unique beer between the Irish – British stout and the German – Austrian dark beers. The beer is still very drinkable, not a real full mouthfeel, and not sweet.

products.name: Pilsner
products.description: 5.2% ABV · 35 IBU · A German-style pilsner, brewed with floor-malted barley grown in the Bamberg. Pale blonde with a white head, this crisp lager presents a lightly bready nose with some floral notes. Mouthfeel is very light, with a crisp hop finish. The malt aroma continues on the palate with bread and light honey notes, complimented by floral, spicy hops. Bitterness is medium, but very clean. Finishes dry and clean.

products.name: Golden Ale
products.description: 6% ABV · 15 IBU · Our take on a classic Golden Ale will quench your thirst and leave you ready for another. The light honeyed breadiness of the malt is balanced with "just the kiss of the hops," showing a light orange aroma.

products.name: IPA
products.description: 5.8% ABV · 50 IBU · Our India Pale Ale is brewed with four hop additions to create a powerful hop profile. A solid malt base, however, tempers the bitter American hops, giving our IPA a balance not often found in this style. The end product is a well-balanced, malty beer with the crisp taste of hops and an exceptionally fruity nose.

products.name: Pils Shandy
products.description: 3.00% ABV · One of summer's simple pleasures comes in Shandy form. We took our classic Summer Pils and evolved it into just that a bright a lemony summertime refresher!
